collection.title: Renault Megane Cabrio 2006 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Renault Megane Cabrio 2006 to 2010 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment.
